{{Top|leg}}
A '''power wagon''' was a military [[Hovercraft|ground-effect vehicle]]. It was armed with [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] turrets and could serve as a mobile [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] for [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] units.
